claims.claim: The proposal requests $298,250, equivalent to 1,193,000 ADA, to support Technical Steering Committee activities for 12 months.
The work is divided into three work packages totaling 1,193,000 ADA: WP1 at 256,000 ADA, WP2 at 832,000 ADA, and WP3 at 105,000 ADA.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
All expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not, at time of submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, including possible deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

The Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.
Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified reserve and project-specific addresses, role-based approvals, and an external Oversight Committee of six entities.
A dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is available for the community to audit and track metrics related to the withdrawn ADA, with activity also immutably verifiable on chain.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of TSC support through three work packages, provides high-level budget allocation and smart-contract custody details, and asserts oversight, audit, reporting, and return-of-unused-funds commitments while relying on external references for Hydra voting, audits, smart contracts, and dashboard verification.
